What makes this bed linen so luxurious?
Our ‘Un Applicato’ bed linen is woven in wonderfully soft and shiny satin. This 100% Egyptian cotton sateen is made of 300 thread count, which gives a superbly luxurious appeal and a silky soft feel against your skin. The thread count is carefully selected to complement the insulating and breathing capabilities of our down duvets and pillows.

Oxford border design: This bed linen has a single white application on a white base color and Oxford borders.

Care of this product:
– Machine wash with warm water on a gentle cycle.
– Do not use bleach (bleaching may weaken fabric and cause yellowing).
– Do not use fabric softener.
– Wash dark colors separately.
– Tumble dry on low heat.
– Remove while still damp.
– Iron on “cotton” setting to regain luster and sheen.
